nextStoryContext: All 3 non-operator stories in this PRD now pass (US-001 commit-existence gate in result.ts, US-002 wiring it from host.ts + loop.ts with anchored git detection, US-003 this story). US-003 added DEFAULT_CONTAINER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS (60 min, loop.ts) and made the perWorkerTimeoutMs fallback isolation-aware: `opts.perWorkerTimeoutMs ?? (opts.workerIsolation === 'container' ? DEFAULT_CONTAINER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS : DEFAULT_PER_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS)`. In host.ts, the CAM_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS env resolver was RELOCATED (not just edited) from ~line 244 to right after `const workerIsolation = readWorkerIsolation(...)` (now ~line 447) so the fallback can read workerIsolation; this was safe because perWorkerTimeoutMs had zero usages between its old declaration site and its first real usage (`timeoutMs: perWorkerTimeoutMs` in the makeReviewDispatch call, which comes after workerIsolation is resolved). The next implementer picking up this branch should run `jq -r '.userStories[] | select(.passes==false)' scripts/cam/prd.json` first: if empty (as it is right now), the correct action is CAM_IMPLEMENTER_STATUS=PRD_COMPLETE, not another story pick. No known open gaps left by this story.
